response.title: which solar generator for home backup is the best value with panels included
response.answer:
For home backup with solar panels included, I would focus on systems with at least 2,000Wh (2kWh) of battery capacity, a LiFePO4 battery, and 400W or more of solar panels.

The best value isn't necessarily the cheapest kit. It's the one that gives you the most usable battery storage, enough inverter power to run your appliances, and sufficient solar input to recharge during a prolonged outage.

For most homes, I'd compare EcoFlow, BLUETTI, Anker SOLIX, and Jackery before buying.
